name: Vesla Three
description: Vesla Three was a planet located in the Vesla system of the Outer Rim's Corosi sector. The Sith Lord Darth Mekhis tested one of her new superweapons on the planet during the Cold War, ripping apart Vesla Three with gravity-manipulating technology.
